claims.claim: Samsung plans to raise V9 NAND output at its Xi'an X2 fab from about 10,000 to about 50,000 300 mm wafers a month by the end of 2027.
claims.episode_span: The X2 line now turns out about 10,000 300 mm wafers a month of 286-layer V9; the plan is about 50,000 by the end of 2027
claims.source_title: Samsung Doubles Down on V9 NAND in China
claims.supporting_quote: Sources tell SED that the X2 fab currently produces about 10,000 300 mm wafers of the 286-layer V9 NAND per month, and the plan is to raise that figure to around 50,000.

claims.claim: Samsung plans to move V9 equipment into X2 around February 2027 and finish the conversion by November 2027, and to switch 20% to 30% of the existing V6 line to V9.
claims.episode_span: equipment moving in around February 2027 and the conversion finished by November 2027, while 20% to 30% of the fab's existing V6 line would also switch to V9
claims.source_title: Samsung Doubles Down on V9 NAND in China
claims.supporting_quote: Samsung will build an electroplating line in X2's empty cleanroom space, move equipment in around February 2027, and finish the conversion by November 2027. Additionally, 20% to 30% of the fab's existing V6 line will also be switched to V9.

claims.claim: TrendForce lowered its 2027 NAND Flash revenue forecast to about US$419.3 billion and its 2027 DRAM revenue forecast to $1.15 trillion after Chinese CSP order cuts.
claims.episode_span: lowered its 2027 NAND Flash revenue forecast to about US$419.3 billion
claims.source_title: Cuts to Chinese CSP Demand Expecting to Slow Memory Industry Revenue Growth in 2027
claims.supporting_quote: TrendForce to lower its 2027 NAND Flash revenue forecast to approximately US$419.3 billion. Meanwhile, although the DRAM market is expected to remain undersupplied, quarterly price increases are projected to moderate. This has led TrendForce to revise its 2027 DRAM revenue forecast downward to $1.15 trillion.

claims.claim: BigGo Finance reports Intel won a Microsoft packaging order but faces a 35% yield wall in a bid to enter the Google TPU supply chain.
claims.episode_span: Intel has won a Microsoft packaging order
claims.source_title: Intel Wins Microsoft Packaging Order but Hits '35% Yield' Wall in Bid to Enter Google TPU Supply Chain
claims.supporting_quote: Intel Wins Microsoft Packaging Order but Hits '35% Yield' Wall in Bid to Enter Google TPU Supply Chain

claims.claim: CoreWeave says LOTA caches data on GPU nodes at up to 7 GB/s per GPU.
claims.episode_span: caches that data on GPU nodes at up to 7 GB/s per GPU
claims.source_title: Robotics data, LOTA caching & physical AI training needs
claims.supporting_quote: On CoreWeave, LOTA (Local Object Transport Accelerator) caches data on GPU nodes at up to 7 GB/s per GPU, so GPUs can train instead of waiting on reads.

claims.claim: APS signed a contract on October 16 to ramp service to about 1.88 gigawatts for TSMC Arizona over an initial 25-year term.
claims.episode_span: Arizona Public Service signed a direct pricing contract on October 16 to ramp service to about 1.88 gigawatts
claims.source_title: TSMC Arizona offers a look at what could come to Brazos County
claims.supporting_quote: Arizona Public Service signed a direct pricing contract with TSMC Arizona on Oct. 16, according to the latest quarterly report APS parent company Pinnacle West filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Under the deal, APS would ramp service up to about 1.88 gigawatts to power TSMC’s fabs and advanced packaging plants for an initial 25-year term.

claims.claim: TSMC Arizona uses 4.75 million gallons of water a day and says it recycles 65%, about 3.5 million gallons a day.
claims.episode_span: the campus uses 4.75 million gallons of water a day
claims.source_title: TSMC Arizona offers a look at what could come to Brazos County
claims.supporting_quote: Engineers at TSMC’s Water Resource Center say the campus currently uses 4.75 million gallons of water a day.

claims.claim: Schumer alleged on November 24 that Jensen Huang violated US export controls by shipping advanced chips to China, and hearings are set for December 1 and December 3.
claims.episode_span: Chuck Schumer wrote on X on Tuesday, November 24
claims.source_title: US lawmakers from both parties pressure Nvidia, call for tighter chip export controls on China
claims.supporting_quote: US Senate Banking Committee chairman Tim Scott said on Monday that Huang would attend a public hearing before the committee on 3 December. Huang is also expected to attend a closed-door briefing held by three House committees on 1 December.

claims.claim: Deputy Comptroller Noah Betz recommended TSMC's JETI application on November 24, with an estimated $354 million school tax break over 20 years.
claims.episode_span: Noah Betz signed a recommendation on November 24
claims.source_title: TSMC tax break application heads to governor and school district
claims.supporting_quote: Deputy Comptroller Noah Betz signed a recommendation packet for the company Tuesday, Nov. 24, stating that the company meets the eligibility requirements for the tax incentive program.

claims.claim: A forensic study found six Chinese models since April 2026 with Blackwell-consistent fingerprints of 148 or 152 cores, validated on 24 disclosed models.
claims.episode_span: Six models released since April 2026 by DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group
claims.source_title: Chinese AI Models Show Evidence of NVIDIA Blackwell Chip Use
claims.supporting_quote: Six models released by these companies since April 2026 contain numerical patterns consistent with Blackwell hardware, whereas earlier models from the same firms align with the previous Hopper generation.

claims.claim: College Station ISD's JETI hearing is December 10, 2026, and the governor has until December 24, 2026.
claims.episode_span: College Station ISD holds a public hearing at 5 p.m. on December 10, 2026
claims.source_title: TSMC tax break application heads to governor and school district
claims.supporting_quote: College Station ISD will hold a public hearing on Dec. 10 to discuss the JETI application and reinvestment zone

claims.claim: TSMC Arizona collateral payments start January 1, 2027, and a water reclamation plant is due in 2028 to push reuse above 95%.
claims.episode_span: credit support and collateral starting January 1, 2027
claims.source_title: TSMC Arizona offers a look at what could come to Brazos County
claims.supporting_quote: The contract calls for TSMC to make upfront credit support payments and post collateral starting Jan. 1, 2027, to back the new resources APS develops to meet that demand.
